articles.summary: DALLAS, May 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — NexPoint Capital, Inc. (the “Company”), a non-traded publicly registered business development company sponsored and managed by NexPoint Advisors, L.P. (the “Investment Adviser”), today announced that it will commence a voluntary tender offer on or about May 15, 2026 (the “Tender Offer”) for up to 1.0% of its outstanding common stock (“Shares”). […]
articles.title: NexPoint Capital, Inc. Announces Tender Offer for Common Stock
